title: Three separate epilogue lines about Tamsin and the mine read as mutually inconsistent when placed together: one says she 'sounds tired more than angry,' another says she 'has not spoken about the mine, or the miners, or much else, since Cinderhall sold them out,' a third says she 'made them answer for it, and never asked if you approved' — these read like alternate branch-outcomes all being narrated as simultaneously true.
